title: betterredstonee
description: You con make redstone-tools and new blocks
body:
![Redstone tools](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dee43cbeb89d81477f9fd4fa010043fe1fcc6eb9.png)

You can make Redstone-tools and more redstone-blocks

There are the standard tools as well as stairs, slabs and walls from redstone.

The tools consist of sticks and redstone-ingots.

Redstone can be melted in the furnance
